thread:
tara: Quick follow-up from the DB-node postmortem — we agreed to attack alert noise and pager churn. I sketched action items below, please ack and claim owners/timelines.

- A1: dedupe high-cardinality DB replication alerts (owner: ?)
- A2: raise OK/Warning thresholds for db_conn_saturation on replicas
- A3: implement suppression window for repeated flaky alerts
- A4: update paging policy: only page on critical after 3 duplicates in 5m
- A5: add periodic noise sweep job and dashboard

Please reply with your item or suggest edits. Target: PRs + runbook updates by EOD next Wed.

phil: I can take A1 (dedupe). Will open a PR that normalizes labels and adds grouping in Alertmanager. Plan: branch + PR by Mon. Suggest using grouping_label: replica_id (not instance) to reduce fanout. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll own A4 (paging policy). Proposed snippet for route config to avoid single-flap pages:

```
route:
  receiver: 'pager'
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 1h
  continue: false
  matchers:
    severity: 'critical'
```

I'll canary this policy next Tue during our low-traffic window.

sam: Taking A3 + A5. I'll add an Alertmanager inhibition rule and a scheduled noise-sweep that queries alerts with >10 flaps/day, then surface candidates in a dashboard. Will also add a short runbook section for how to lift suppression during real incidents. PR ETA: Thu.

oncall-bot: Created tickets: INF-2176 (dedupe), INF-2177 (paging-policy), INF-2178 (suppression+noise-sweep). Links: https://jira.internal/browse/INF-2176, https://jira.internal/browse/INF-2177, https://jira.internal/browse/INF-2178

phil: quick Q — A2 thresholds for db_conn_saturation, do we want to move that under me too? I can draft numbers based on 95th percentile from last 30 days.

tara: yes, pair phil + sam on A2. I'll create INF-2179 for thresholds. Target: thresholds QAed by Fri.

kevin: noted, I'll update the oncall runbook with the new page conditions and add an explicit rollback step in case the dedupe causes missed pages.

sam: added a checklist to INF-2178 and pasted the regex we use to normalize instance labels into the ticket. PR coming in ~4h.

tara: awesome, thanks everyone. If PRs run into blockers ping me here and I'll book a 15m sync. :white_check_mark:
